| # ISOBUS specifications {#isobus-specifications-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The following specifications have been taken into account for the implementation of the ISOBUS communication stack.

- ISO11783-3 Data Link Layer

- ISO11783-5 Network Management Layer

- ISO11783-12 Diagnostics

More information about the ISOBUS standard can be found on the ISO website:

[http://www.iso.org](http://www.iso.org){.weblink target="_blank"}
